chunks.say: Hey human. Yes, you.
chunks.sub: Hey human. Yes, you.

chunks.say: Did you just call me a bird-brain?
chunks.sub: Did you just call me a bird-brain?

chunks.say: Let me tell you something. I can recognise myself in a mirror. Dogs cannot. Cats cannot. Pigeons can.
chunks.sub: I can recognise myself in a mirror. Dogs cannot. Cats cannot.

chunks.say: Scientists even taught us to tell the difference between paintings by Monet and Picasso.
chunks.sub: Scientists taught pigeons to tell Monet from Picasso.

chunks.say: Can YOU do that? Exactly.
chunks.sub: Can YOU do that? Exactly.

chunks.say: Next time, show some respect. I'm basically a feathered genius.
chunks.sub: Show some respect. I'm a feathered genius.

chunks.say: Darling... you don't understand my pain.
chunks.sub: Darling, you don't understand my pain.

chunks.say: I have THREE hearts. Two pump blood to my gills, one to the rest of me. So when someone breaks my heart, it's a triple tragedy.
chunks.sub: I have THREE hearts. Two for my gills, one for my body.

chunks.say: And it gets worse. My blood is blue, because it uses copper instead of iron. Even my sadness is fancy.
chunks.sub: My blood is blue, because it uses copper, not iron.

chunks.say: Also, when I swim, my main heart stops beating. Yes, swimming literally exhausts me.
chunks.sub: When I swim, my main heart stops beating.

chunks.say: Being dramatic is just good biology.
chunks.sub: Being dramatic is just good biology.

chunks.say: Good... morning... Is it Tuesday? Or... Thursday?
chunks.sub: Good... morning... Is it Tuesday? Or Thursday?

chunks.say: Big... adventure today. I need to... climb down... the tree.
chunks.sub: Big adventure today. Climbing down the tree.

chunks.say: Why? I only go to the bathroom... once a week. On the ground. It takes... hours.
chunks.sub: I only go to the bathroom once a week.

chunks.say: Sloths are so slow... algae grows on our fur. I'm basically... a walking garden.
chunks.sub: Algae grows on my fur. I'm a walking garden.

chunks.say: Now... excuse me... I have... plans... next week.
chunks.sub: Excuse me... I have plans... next week.

chunks.say: Everyone thinks only mammals make milk.
chunks.sub: Everyone thinks only mammals make milk.

chunks.say: Wrong, cow. I make milk too. It's called crop milk, and I make it in my throat.
chunks.sub: Wrong, cow. I make milk too. It's called crop milk.

chunks.say: And here's the best part: dad pigeons make it too. Both parents feed the babies. Yes, I'm a dad and a milk factory.
chunks.sub: Dad pigeons make it too. Both parents feed the babies.

chunks.say: Flamingos and penguins do it as well.
chunks.sub: Flamingos and penguins do it as well.

chunks.say: So next time you're stepping around me on the pavement, remember: I'm doing more parenting than your whole street.
chunks.sub: I'm doing more parenting than your whole street.

chunks.say: People ask how I multitask. Simple.
chunks.sub: People ask how I multitask. Simple.

chunks.say: About two thirds of my neurons are in my arms, not my head.
chunks.sub: Two thirds of my neurons are in my ARMS, not my head.

chunks.say: Each arm can think for itself. Left arm number three is sipping tea, and has no idea what arm number six is doing.
chunks.sub: Each arm can think for itself.

chunks.say: My head just says, please, everyone, behave.
chunks.sub: My head just says, please, everyone, behave.

chunks.say: Honestly, I'm not one octopus. I'm basically a team of eight, and nobody has a manager. Send help.
chunks.sub: I'm a team of eight with no manager.

chunks.say: They say... I sleep... twenty hours a day. That is... rude.
chunks.sub: They say I sleep twenty hours a day. Rude.

chunks.say: And also... wrong. Scientists tracked wild sloths. We sleep about ten hours.
chunks.sub: Scientists tracked wild sloths. We sleep about ten hours.

chunks.say: Only sloths in zoos... sleep more, because... they're bored.
chunks.sub: Sloths in zoos sleep more, because they're bored.

chunks.say: I'm not lazy... I'm saving energy. My food is... low in calories.
chunks.sub: My leafy food is low in calories. So I save energy.

chunks.say: It's not laziness... it's a lifestyle.
chunks.sub: It's not laziness. It's a lifestyle.

chunks.say: Human. Are you lost? Again?
chunks.sub: Human. Are you lost? Again?

chunks.say: I can fly home from over a thousand kilometres away, in places I've never been.
chunks.sub: I can fly home from over a thousand kilometres away.

chunks.say: No phone. No map. I use the sun, smells, and even the Earth's magnetic field. Yes, I have a built-in compass.
chunks.sub: No phone. No map. Sun, smells, and Earth's magnetic field.

chunks.say: That's why people used us as messengers, even in wars.
chunks.sub: That's why people used us as messengers.

chunks.say: And you? You can't find the exit in a shopping mall. Follow me. Slowly. Keep up.
chunks.sub: You can't find the mall exit. Follow me.

chunks.say: Locked me in an aquarium? Adorable.
chunks.sub: Locked me in an aquarium? Adorable.

chunks.say: I have no bones, only a hard little beak. If my beak fits through a gap, the rest of me follows.
chunks.sub: No bones. Only a beak. If it fits, I fit.

chunks.say: A crack in a lid? Door. A drain pipe? Highway.
chunks.sub: A crack in a lid? Door. A drain pipe? Highway.

chunks.say: One octopus in New Zealand, named Inky, escaped his tank and slid down a drain into the sea. Nobody saw it happen.
chunks.sub: Inky the octopus escaped his tank and slid into the sea.

chunks.say: Goodbye, humans. Thanks for the snacks.
chunks.sub: Goodbye, humans. Thanks for the snacks.

chunks.say: On land... I'm slow. In water... I'm a legend.
chunks.sub: On land, I'm slow. In water, I'm a legend.

chunks.say: Sloths are great swimmers. We paddle with our long arms... much faster than on land.
chunks.sub: Sloths are great swimmers. Much faster than on land.

chunks.say: We can hold our breath... for around forty minutes.
chunks.sub: We can hold our breath for around forty minutes.

chunks.say: We slow... our... heart down. The only thing... I do... on purpose.
chunks.sub: We slow our heart down to do it.

chunks.say: Meet me at the river. Bring snacks.
chunks.sub: Meet me at the river. Bring snacks.

chunks.say: You keep asking, why do you bob your head? I'm not dancing. Mostly.
chunks.sub: Why do I bob my head? I'm not dancing. Mostly.

chunks.say: When I walk, my head jerks forward, then stays still while my body catches up.
chunks.sub: My head holds still while my body catches up.

chunks.say: That holds the picture steady, like a camera on a tripod.
chunks.sub: That keeps the picture steady, like a tripod.

chunks.say: My eyes are on the sides of my head, so I see almost all around me, with only a tiny blind spot behind.
chunks.sub: My eyes are on the sides. I see almost all around.

chunks.say: So yes, I'm judging you from every angle.
chunks.sub: Yes, I'm judging you from every angle.

chunks.say: Darling, watch this.
chunks.sub: Darling, watch this.

chunks.say: I can change my colour and skin texture in less than a second.
chunks.sub: I change colour and skin texture in under a second.

chunks.say: Rock? Done. Seaweed? Done. Sand? Obviously.
chunks.sub: Rock? Done. Seaweed? Done. Sand? Obviously.

chunks.say: Here's the plot twist: scientists think my eyes can't even see colour.
chunks.sub: Scientists think my eyes can't see colour.

chunks.say: I'm basically a fashion designer who's colour-blind. And yet I'm never wrong. Talent. Pure talent. Applause is optional, but encouraged.
chunks.sub: A colour-blind fashion designer. Pure talent.

chunks.say: I just ate... a leaf. Please check back... in a month.
chunks.sub: I just ate a leaf. Check back in a month.

chunks.say: Sloths digest food... very slowly. A single meal can take weeks.
chunks.sub: A single meal can take weeks to digest.

chunks.say: Leaves are tough... and we have a big... slow stomach... full of helpful microbes.
chunks.sub: Leaves are tough. We have a big, slow stomach.

chunks.say: My lunch... is still... in progress. It was... a good leaf.
chunks.sub: My lunch is still in progress.

chunks.say: Do not... rush me. I'm digesting... and judging you.
chunks.sub: Do not rush me. I'm digesting.

chunks.say: Doctor Pidge, at your service.
chunks.sub: Doctor Pidge, at your service.

chunks.say: Researchers trained pigeons to look at medical images and spot signs of cancer, and the pigeons did surprisingly well.
chunks.sub: Pigeons were trained to spot signs of cancer in images.

chunks.say: Pigeons can also recognise human faces, and learn to tell letters of the alphabet apart.
chunks.sub: We recognise human faces. We tell letters apart.

chunks.say: And you called me a bird-brain? I have a better eye than most of your interns.
chunks.sub: And you called me a bird-brain?

chunks.say: Please, address me as Doctor. Payment is accepted in breadcrumbs.
chunks.sub: Call me Doctor. Payment: breadcrumbs.

chunks.say: Housing prices are crazy, darling. So I made my own home.
chunks.sub: Housing prices are crazy, darling.

chunks.say: Veined octopuses pick up coconut shells, carry them across the sea floor, and hide inside when danger shows up.
chunks.sub: Veined octopuses carry coconut shells to hide in.

chunks.say: That's tool use, and most animals can't do it.
chunks.sub: That's tool use. Most animals can't do it.

chunks.say: Do I look silly, walking with a house? Yes. Am I safe from sharks? Also yes.
chunks.sub: Do I look silly? Yes. Am I safe? Also yes.

chunks.say: Your move, humans. Show me your mortgage.
chunks.sub: Your move, humans. Show me your mortgage.

chunks.say: Do you... want to see... something impressive?
chunks.sub: Want to see something impressive?

chunks.say: I can turn my head... almost all the way around. About two hundred and seventy degrees.
chunks.sub: I can turn my head almost 270 degrees.

chunks.say: Sloths have extra bones... in our necks.
chunks.sub: Sloths have extra bones in our necks.

chunks.say: So I can see behind me... without moving my body. Which is perfect... because moving... is a lot.
chunks.sub: I see behind me without moving my body.

chunks.say: Follow... for more. I'll post... eventually.
chunks.sub: Follow for more. I'll post eventually.
